summary: Willamette NF lookout announced for Harvey Mountain in June and July 1933 as CCC work; no source confirms it was built or what became of it.

events.note: June 1933 announcement that one of three new lookout houses would be erected on Harvey Mountain that summer; a July 1933 CCC construction announcement names it again. Completion is not reported.

evidence.supports: June 1933 announcement that three new lookout houses would be erected in the Willamette forest that summer
evidence.quote: Three new lookout houses will be erected on peaks in the Willamette forest this summer

evidence.supports: June 1933 item places one of the houses on Harvey Mountain

notes_for_editor: Single source. The page quotes two 1933 Eugene Register-Guard items, both announcements of plans. Nothing we read confirms the tower was finished, staffed, burned, moved or removed, so the story says only what the announcements say. Status and access are left out of facts; the brief's status 'unknown' should stay until a completion or removal record turns up. Searches found nothing else: the Willamette NF history PDF on foresthistory.org has no mention of Harvey, and the firelookout.org Oregon list and the Cheryl Hill standing-lookouts page do not name it (absence noted, not used as evidence). Do not confuse this with the Harvey Mountain Lookout in Plumas County, California (NHLR, US-CA), a different tower; search results also showed a 1937 'Harvey Mountain, federal lookout' in California's Termo district. Those were excluded.
